**Arabis · Climate Explorer**

Explore 71 collection sites and 301 samples. Click a site to compare temperature, precipitation, and elevation, or select samples to download their WorldClim 2.1 bioclimatic values.

[Open app in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics2.shinyapps.io/arabis-climate-explorer/)
